name: Blade_Tempered

unity.note: FBX: Blender -Y forward becomes Unity +Z. Positions below are in the model root's space, Unity axes.

notes: Tempered Aether Blade (damage x1.35, costs 18 shards). Longer and slimmer, with a glowing fuller. Grip centred on the origin; Base/Tip empties give the blade segment for the sweep test. The _Glow child uses AF_Glow: give it an additive shader.
